mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing the present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period signals improving labor market conditions, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 55% of instances where UNRATE falls > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the effect size is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and industrial production (both rising above their 3-month moving averages) indicates a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both above 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO are above their 3-month moving averages, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3% annualized), rising consumer prices erode corporate profit margins and prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3% annualized, or the effect size is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth, as measured by RSAFS, indicates robust consumer spending which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high RSAFS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production exceeding 1.0% signals a strengthening manufacturing sector, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 55% of instances where INDPRO rises > 1.0% in 1 month, or the effect size is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points and a federal funds rate below 1.0% indicates a coordinated economic recovery and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances where UNRATE falls > 0.3pp and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST above 5-year average), rising home construction activity signals improving consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 55% of instances where HOUST is above its 5-year average, or the effect size is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
